title: Surface patterns, softer baked light and modelled detail in the game
question: Your picks 2, 4 and 8 are in all three places now. Does each one look right, or should any change?

media.caption: Office close up: before and after (all three on)
Gate close up: the plant pot and the bench fabric get patterns too

options.label: surfaces. Surface patterns on every model, with a switch in Settings
options.note: Every model except the people: floors, walls, desks, chairs, benches, plant pots, mugs, metal. Settings > Graphics > Surface detail turns it off and on at once.

options.label: bake-soft. Baked light, softer
options.note: About half the darkening of the first version, and less warmth. Left: the first version, right: the softer one.

options.label: detail. Modelled detail as in the showcase
options.note: Desks with keyboards, trays, pen cups and drawer handles; chairs with a five-star base; plant pots with a rim, saucer and pebbles; doors with panels, handles and hinges; skirting and wall caps; shelves and filing cabinets; mugs with handles.

links.label: Office with the first (hard) baked light

decision: all three approved: surfaces 'looks good', bake-soft 'good', detail 'great'
